entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Tatuja pachi, piá Maléiwa, piain ainjin taya zupúla terrájuin piá ma ajíshin tapula piá Tatuja such jolucho, marchin tayá ma piainja katchin, muliesħayá pumá paisnja washirin.
Okokipe na ni mom onyankí yapi, Nímaye detaunaxan da souqapoiqui ca lchie, Nimaye qaica ca iben'a.
